title: smiley bee
description: This modpack is ment to have fun with your friends or by your self
body: This modpack adds many mods like create, essentails, immerseive, aircraft and much more. This modpack aims to be fun for you and your friends to play on its super fun in both singleplayer and multiplayer and you can find new biomes thanks to terralith and many new strucrures. I think you should download this modpack for you or with friends to play :)
